snippet.title: Taste of heaven Trailer
snippet.description:
Taste of heaven is a 2D cooking RPG with a pinch of roguelite
Master the art of crafting dishes for celestial gourmets while forging bonds with a cast of unforgettable characters. 

Discover hidden recipes and explore a vibrant, ever-changing world brimming with charm and mystery !

Please wishlist the game at 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835080/Taste_Of_Heaven
